records: fixed 16 real N16 materializations: 4 positive CE, 4 conditional KL, 8 normal KL-plus-margin; records are length-sorted within each microbatch and no labels, masks, denominators, or coefficient changes are permitted
execution: one forward/backward per microbatch, immediately free graph, no optimizer/scheduler/update/save/cold/scientific fit
selection: fastest passing configuration by measured target tokens per wall second, then lower microbatch only for an exact throughput tie; memory occupancy alone is not a selection metric
